capabilities: Sync notes, attachments and folders across devices via a self-hosted server
Sync vault settings, themes, snippets and community plugin files
Encrypt vault content and paths end-to-end with an optional passphrase
Browse and restore stored file version history
Resolve conflicts with per-file revisions, tombstones and atomic batches
extras: README warns the plugin was built with heavy AI assistance ('vibecoded'), is young, and should not be the only copy of important data. It is not yet in the community plugin store and must be built manually. Licensed AGPLv3; paid versions are not authorized.
intentEvidence: Syncy is not compatible with Obsidian's official, private Sync protocol.
motivation: The author built it so users can sync on their own infrastructure without a monthly per-vault sync bill.
problem: Obsidian's official Sync is a paid, closed service, leaving no self-hosted option that syncs the full vault including settings and plugin data.

relations.evidence: Syncy is not compatible with Obsidian's official, private Sync protocol.

summary: Self-hosted sync client that keeps notes, attachments, plugins, themes and vault settings in sync with a companion Syncy server.
